name: Blood and Duty: the Wounded Graysky Soldiers are wounded and stay wounded for the next player (COA-9553)
contract: Blood and Duty 175049 asks the player to tend six Wounded Graysky Soldiers (164055 credit, 164056 at Graysky Outpost) with the Roll of Thick Bandage, a First Aid channel (365018). The soldiers' spawns hold 1 health and they do not regenerate, so they stand wounded. A bandage gives the credit, and 30 s later the soldier is back at 5% health for the next player.

steps.label: a bandages the soldier with the Roll of Thick Bandage
SETUP: the First Aid channel starts
the First Aid channel ends and the soldier waits 30 s
the tended soldier is wounded again for the next player
DISCRIMINATING: the outpost's spawned soldiers stand wounded, not at full health
